---
name: Research direction
about: A construction or method to test, beyond what the package implements
---

## Idea

<!-- Two sentences. -->

## Mechanism

<!-- Why it should work, with the mathematics. State how each chain's marginal transition stays exact and how chains stay together after meeting, or the other route to unbiasedness. -->

## What is new

<!-- The nearest published work, each with authors, year, title and arXiv identifier or DOI, retrieved, not recalled. The novelty verdict: already done, refuted, or open (with the searches that found nothing). -->

## Predicted outcome

<!-- Quantitative where possible: how the meeting time or the variance should scale. -->

## Falsification test

<!-- The cheapest experiment whose result would show the idea fails: targets, budget in evaluations, seeds fixed in advance, and the threshold. -->

## Evidence

<!-- Filled in as experiments finish: scripts and outputs in notes/experiments/, the verdict, and the next experiment. A direction that fails is closed with its negative result. -->
